ctx.x: Albert Ammons, Meade Lux Lewis—oh, they could really play. Two hands, you know they played two pianos. They went to New York and played at Café Society. Two fat men at the piano, they could really play boogie-woogie all. You have to have endurance and persistence to play that long. Pete Johnson, that completes it.
Pete was a pianist, the rest of them are boogie-woogie players.
